note: B-243 (contract 11.5.1, D-195): the far disc's own facts for the giants' close view, from the table the far disc is painted from (giants_v3). u right, v up, in disc radii; tones are the far disc's flat tones (the Earth palette, as every disc)

edge_wobble.formula: edge y(x) = v_top - amp * sin(freq * pi * x + phase) * (1 - v_top^2); phase = 2 * pi * frame / loop_frames

dashes.formula: per edge vb and per u0: uu = u0 + drift * sin(phase + vb * drift_per_v); the dash runs u = uu ... uu + length at v(u) = vb + wave_amp * sin(wave_freq * u + phase); skipped where (|uu| + length)^2 + vb^2 > limit; phase = 2 * pi * frame / loop_frames

night_hatches.formula: stroke j (0 .. count - 1) of a group (u0, v0) = its u, v: from (u0 + step * j - length / 2, v0 + step * j - length / 2) to (+ length / 2, + length / 2); skipped where u^2 + v^2 > limit at its centre

ink_marks.note: drawn over everything, storms included, as on the far disc

night.note: the face outside this circle is the night crescent: each tone mixed t of the way to toward_hex (night_hex per belt)

storms.name: dark_storm
storms.note: lon in turns of the body at frame 0 (it advances by drift_turns_per_loop * frame / loop_frames); v and radius in disc radii

storms.name: companion_cloud
storms.note: lon in turns of the body at frame 0 (it advances by drift_turns_per_loop * frame / loop_frames); v and radius in disc radii

streak.note: the close view draws this streak (in the blobs' own coordinates) instead of the blobs: along it (t = 0 .. 1) its radius is radius * (s + (1 - s) * sin(pi * t) ^ 0.6), s = end_radius_share (tapered ends: a cirrus streak, LEAD 23:4x), and its outline takes belt_edge's ragged cut

strips.note: scale = strip texels per far-disc texel, ONE scale fixed to the planet at every zoom (no stepping); u runs along each curve from the body's own left, the limb with a whole number of repeats; cut_row is the row the strip's line or cut sits on, counted from the strip's top (limb_band: its ink's centre line; v = cut_row - the signed distance in strip texels); the pigment tile lies over the far sheet's frame (disc.json's frame_width x frame_height), value / 127.5; the grain is laid in screen space, value / 127.5

rim.formula: the limb, in disc radii: r(angle) = 1 + a3 * sin(3 * angle + ph3) + a5 * sin(5 * angle + ph5); angle = atan2(v, u)
